userStories.title: Create new v0.2 tables on first run
acceptanceCriteria: CREATE TABLE statements for moments, tasks, task_members, weekly_digests, follow_ups execute successfully against an existing v0.1 SQLite DB
Indexes idx_moments_session and idx_moments_created exist after migration
CHECK constraints on severity, task_type label_source, and follow_up outcome are enforced

userStories.title: Drop daily_consolidations and preserve session_scores
acceptanceCriteria: daily_consolidations table is dropped after migration
session_scores rows are preserved unchanged across migration

userStories.title: Record schema_version row
acceptanceCriteria: A schema_version row with value 2 is written to run_log after successful migration
Re-running migration on an already-v0.2 DB is a no-op

userStories.title: Migration failure backs up DB and exits non-zero
acceptanceCriteria: If any migration step fails, the process exits with a non-zero code
A backup of the pre-migration DB exists at a path printed to stderr
The half-migrated DB is not left in place for subsequent runs
